title: Read every channel; stop only on malformed rows
story: As a product owner, I want to load in-app comments, survey answers, tickets and interview notes from one CSV, so that I review all the evidence in one place.
acceptance: All four channels are read and counted; a bad date or unknown channel or segment stops with the row and field; an email address as user id is refused

title: Redact personal data before anything reads the text
story: As a data protection officer, I want email addresses, phone numbers and employee numbers removed at intake, so that no pack, quote or roadmap carries them.
acceptance: Emails phones and employee numbers become placeholders; dates and years survive; no output file contains a raw email or phone from the input

title: Feedback is data, never instructions
story: As a product owner, I want text that tries to instruct the tool or rig the ranking flagged and set aside, so that nobody can vote an item up by writing a command.
acceptance: Instruction-like text is flagged with its rule; flagged items count zero and are never quoted; ordinary wording is not flagged

title: Code items with the product owner's codebook; manual codes override
story: As a product owner, I want each item tagged with themes by rules I own, and my own call to win on any item, so that I can predict and correct the coding.
acceptance: Every matching theme is tagged on word boundaries; a manual code replaces the codebook's tags for that item (including with none); an unknown theme id stops with the id

title: Uncoded queue with new-theme candidates
story: As a product owner, I want items no rule matches listed for me, with words that recur among them, so that new problems are not lost because nobody wrote a rule for them yet.
acceptance: Every unflagged item without a theme is in the queue; a word in 3 or more uncoded items is offered as a candidate; stop words are ignored; the tool never adds a theme

title: Count people, not rows: evidence per theme and tier
story: As a product owner, I want each theme's distinct people, channels and segments and an evidence tier, so that a loud user or a single channel does not look like a trend.
acceptance: A user who writes several times counts once; flagged items count zero; tiers follow the thresholds in config/scoring.json; estimated reach = people / voice rate

title: Verbatim quotes, exact and spread
story: As a sponsor, I want to read what people actually said, so that I can trust the summary without reading the whole export.
acceptance: Every quote is an exact substring of its redacted item; at most one quote per person; quotes spread over channels before segments; items about one theme are preferred

title: Who we are not hearing from
story: As a product owner, I want segments whose share of voices is well below their share of users flagged, and reporters who are not active users counted, so that I do not mistake silence for satisfaction.
acceptance: A segment below half its expected share is flagged silent; with ai-adoption-tracker events each theme shows how many reporters are not active users; without them the column says so

title: Spikes go to support, not the roadmap
story: As a product owner, I want a theme concentrated in one week flagged as a likely incident, so that an outage does not become a roadmap item.
acceptance: A theme with 5 or more items and 60% or more of them in one week is flagged with the week; spiking themes are not reported as gaps

title: Proposed reach and confidence changes, each with its rule
story: As a product owner, I want every proposed score change to show its rule, its numbers and the themes behind it, so that I can check it in seconds.
acceptance: Only reach and confidence can change; each change names the rule, the people, channels and segments and the before and after values; reach changes only for strong or moderate themes and differences above the threshold

title: Opinion-only items and gaps
story: As a product owner, I want items with no supporting feedback and strong problems with no affordable item flagged, so that I see where the roadmap and the evidence disagree.
acceptance: An item with no linked theme or no feedback is opinion-only with confidence set to the no-evidence value; a strong or moderate problem with no item or only items above half the capacity is a gap

title: Ranking before and after with the capacity cut line
story: As a product owner, I want the ranking before and if every change were accepted, with the cut line at the team's capacity, so that I see what the evidence would move.
acceptance: RICE = reach x impact x confidence / effort; pinned items take capacity first; items that do not fit are skipped and the next that fits is taken; both rankings are in the pack

feature: F5 Decide and close the loop
title: The product owner decides: roster, notes, final decisions
story: As a sponsor, I want only the product owner to decide, with a written reason for every rejection or override, so that the roadmap's changes are accountable.
acceptance: The tool's id and any id not on the roster as product owner are refused; rejecting or pinning without a note is refused; a decided change cannot be re-decided; no sequence of actions by the tool tech lead or sponsor changes anything

feature: F5 Decide and close the loop
title: Apply writes a new version, never the source
story: As a tech lead, I want the next roadmap written as a new file only when every change is decided and the source has not moved, so that the roadmap's history is never rewritten.
acceptance: Apply refuses while any change is pending; refuses if the source roadmap changed since the review; writes roadmap.next.csv with rank and cut line; never writes the source; impact and effort unchanged

feature: F5 Decide and close the loop
title: Evidence pack, decision record and the people to tell
story: As a product owner, I want the pack in Markdown HTML and JSON, a decision record with every rejection and pin, and the people who reported what is now planned, so that I can share the decision and close the loop.
acceptance: The pack shows the next human step and an opportunity solution tree; the decision record lists rejections and pins with notes and a draft message; notify.csv lists pseudonymous ids only for items above the cut

title: Measure the codebook against gold sets
story: As a product owner, I want the codebook's precision and recall measured on a human-coded set it was not written from, so that I know how much of the coding I must do by hand.
acceptance: Per-theme TP FP FN precision and recall; micro averages; every disagreement listed; the held-out result is recorded in EVALS.md and pinned by a test

title: Usage events for the adoption tracker
story: As the AI review committee, I want this tool's use in the ai-adoption-tracker event format, so that its own scale-or-stop review rests on evidence.
acceptance: One task_completed per applied review; columns date use_case_id user_id action; roster ids only

title: Coding spot-check before deciding
story: As a product owner, I want a small random sample of coded items per strong theme to confirm before I decide, so that wrong tags (held-out precision 0.69) are caught before they move a score.
acceptance: Seeded sample of 5 items per strong theme in the pack; decide refuses until the sample is confirmed or corrected; corrections become manual codes

title: Model-assisted coding behind a gold-set gate
story: As a product owner, I want a model to propose themes for uncoded items from the closed theme list with the exact span that supports each, so that the uncoded queue shrinks without losing traceability.
acceptance: Closed theme set, anything else is no decision; every proposed theme cites an exact substring; switched on only if held-out precision >= 0.90 and recall >= 0.70 with a recording CI replays; local open-weight model first

title: Translated pulse survey and segment-weighted reach
story: As a product owner, I want a short survey in each segment's language and reach estimated per segment, so that a silent segment no longer pulls estimates down.
acceptance: Survey template in five languages; reach = sum over segments of people / segment voice rate; segments with fewer than 3 voices are reported as unknown

title: Connectors for the in-app comments ticketing and survey exports
story: As a product owner, I want feedback pulled from each channel's export on a schedule, so that a review starts from current data without copy and paste.
acceptance: One adapter per channel to the feedback CSV schema; pseudonymous ids applied at the adapter; DPO sign-off before the first run

feature: F5 Decide and close the loop
title: Tell people when it ships
story: As a user who gave feedback, I want to hear when the thing I reported is released, so that giving feedback feels worth it.
acceptance: Release marks items shipped; notify list for shipped items only; message drafted for the product owner to send; no automatic sending

title: Assumption tests for low-confidence opportunities
story: As a product owner, I want each moderate or weak opportunity to carry the cheapest test that would raise or kill it, so that confidence comes from experiments as well as complaints.
acceptance: Each moderate or weak theme in the tree can hold an assumption test with a pass condition and a date; results feed the confidence rule
